```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(heatmaply)
library(htmlwidgets)


data <- read_excel("data/GSE61271_gene_names_and_GSM_headers.xlsx")
data <- as.data.frame(data)



data$Gene <- as.character(data$Gene)
data$Gene[is.na(data$Gene) | data$Gene == ""] <- paste0("Unknown_", which(is.na(data$Gene) | data$Gene == ""))

data <- data[!grepl("^ENSSSCG", data$Gene, ignore.case = TRUE), ]

rownames(data) <- make.unique(data$Gene)

data$Gene <- NULL
data$Gene_name <- NULL

data[] <- lapply(data, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

data <- data[complete.cases(data), ]

row_var <- apply(data, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
data <- data[row_var > 0, ]

gene_variance <- apply(data, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
top_genes <- names(sort(gene_variance, decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
heatmap_data <- data[top_genes, ]


metadata <- read.csv("data/GSE61271_sample_metadata.csv")

metadata2 <- metadata[match(colnames(heatmap_data), metadata$geo_accession), ]

colnames(heatmap_data) <- paste(
  colnames(heatmap_data),
  metadata2$biological_state,
  metadata2$Sex,
  sep = " | "
)

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  BiologicalState = metadata2$biological_state,
  Sex = metadata2$Sex
)

rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_data)


hm <- heatmaply(
  as.matrix(heatmap_data),
  scale = "row",
  Rowv = TRUE,
  Colv = TRUE,
  column_side_colors = annotation_col,
  xlab = "Samples",
  ylab = "Genes",
  main = "Top 50 Most Variable Genes",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8
)

hm



```


```{r}
#| echo: FALSE


library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(conflicted)
library(plotly)

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::rename)

human <- read.csv("data/human_GSVA_BMI_results.csv")
pig <- read.csv("data/pig_GSVA_BMI_results.csv")

# Standardize column names if needed
human <- human %>%
  rename(pathway = 1) %>%
  mutate(Species = "human")

pig <- pig %>%
  rename(pathway = 1) %>%
  mutate(Species = "pig")

# Combine human & pig
combined <- bind_rows(human, pig)

# Add significance + direction
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(
    negLogP = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    significance = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, "Significant", "NS"),
    direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down")
  )

# Interactive volcano plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(
  combined,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = negLogP,
    color = significance,
    text = paste(
      "Pathway:", pathway,
      "<br>Species:", Species,
      "<br>logFC:", round(logFC, 3),
      "<br>adj.P.Val:", signif(adj.P.Val, 3),
      "<br>Direction:", direction
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Species) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "GSVA Pathway Changes with BMI",
    x = "logFC",
    y = "-log10(adj.P.Val)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NS" = "grey", "Significant" = "red"))

ggplotly(volcano_plot, tooltip = "text")

# Add pathway categories
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    pathway %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION",
      "HALLMARK_COAGULATION",
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT"
    ) ~ "Inflammation/Immune",

    pathway %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_GLYCOLYSIS",
      "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION",
      "HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM",
      "HALLMARK_CHOLESTEROL_HOMEOSTASIS",
      "HALLMARK_HEME_METABOLISM",
      "HALLMARK_XENOBIOTIC_METABOLISM",
      "HALLMARK_BILE_ACID_METABOLISM"
    ) ~ "Metabolism",

    pathway %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS",
      "HALLMARK_P53_PATHWAY",
      "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",
      "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1",
      "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V2",
      "HALLMARK_MITOTIC_SPINDLE"
    ) ~ "Cell Cycle/Proliferation",

    pathway %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA",
      "HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY",
      "HALLMARK_UNFOLDED_PROTEIN_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS",
      "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION",
      "HALLMARK_APICAL_SURFACE",
      "HALLMARK_PEROXISOME",
      "HALLMARK_PROTEIN_SECRETION"
    ) ~ "Stress Response",

    pathway %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION",
      "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS",
      "HALLMARK_ANGIOGENESIS",
      "HALLMARK_MYOGENESIS",
      "HALLMARK_SPERMATOGENESIS",
      "HALLMARK_PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS"
    ) ~ "Development/Differentiation",

    pathway %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY",
      "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE",
      "HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP",
      "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_DN",
      "HALLMARK_WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_NOTCH_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_HEDGEHOG_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
      "HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING"
    ) ~ "Signaling",

    pathway %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_DNA_REPAIR",
      "HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_UP",
      "HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_DN"
    ) ~ "DNA Damage",

    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

category_summary <- combined %>%
  group_by(Species, category) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Interactive theme bar plot
theme_plot <- ggplot(
  category_summary,
  aes(
    x = reorder(category, mean_logFC),
    y = mean_logFC,
    fill = Species,
    text = paste(
      "Category:", category,
      "<br>Species:", Species,
      "<br>Mean logFC:", round(mean_logFC, 3),
      "<br>Pathway count:", count
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Biological Themes in Obesity: Human vs Pig",
    x = "",
    y = "Mean logFC"
  )

ggplotly(theme_plot, tooltip = "text")

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(conflicted)

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::rename)

pig_results <- read.csv("data/pig_GSVA_BMI_results.csv")

pig_results <- pig_results %>%
  rename(pathway = 1) %>%
  mutate(
    negLogP = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    significance = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, "Significant", "NS"),
    direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down")
  )

pig_volcano <- ggplot(
  pig_results,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = negLogP,
    color = significance,
    text = paste(
      "Pathway:", pathway,
      "<br>logFC:", round(logFC, 3),
      "<br>adj.P.Val:", signif(adj.P.Val, 3),
      "<br>Direction:", direction
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Pig GSVA Volcano Plot: High vs Low",
    x = "logFC",
    y = "-log10(adj.P.Val)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NS" = "grey", "Significant" = "red"))

ggplotly(pig_volcano, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

  mutate(
    negLogP = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    significance = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, "Significant", "NS"),

  pig_results,

    color = significance,

      "<br>adj.P.Val:", signif(adj.P.Val, 3),
      "<br>Direction:", direction
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +

ggplotly(volcano_plot, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
library(plotly)

# Prepare data
res0.05$significant <- "Not Significant"
res0.05$significant[res0.05$padj < 0.05 & abs(res0.05$log2FoldChange) > 1] <- "Significant"

res0.05$negLogP <- -log10(res0.05$padj)

# Plot
human_volcano <- ggplot(
  res0.05,
  aes(
    x = log2FoldChange,
    y = negLogP,
    color = significant,
    text = paste(
      "Gene:", symbol,
      "<br>log2FC:", round(log2FoldChange, 3),
      "<br>padj:", signif(padj, 3)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Human Differential Expression Volcano Plot")

ggplotly(human_volcano, tooltip = "text")
```
